title: Tennessee Prison Chief Resigns Following Failed Execution
subtitle: Governor Bill Lee orders an independent review after the attempted execution of Christa Pike goes wrong.

summary.en: The head of the Tennessee prison system, Frank Strada, has announced his resignation following a botched execution attempt. Convicted murderer Christa Pike survived two doses of lethal drugs and remains in critical condition at a hospital. Governor Bill Lee has paused all executions in the state while an independent review takes place. Pike’s legal team argues that the incident highlights deep systemic failures within the death penalty process. Authorities have not yet explained why the procedure failed to end her life.
summary.zh: 田納西州監獄系統負責人法蘭克·斯特拉達在一次失敗的死刑執行後宣布辭職。被判謀殺罪的克莉絲塔·派克在接受兩劑致命藥物後倖存，目前仍在醫院處於病危狀態。州長比爾·李已下令在進行獨立審查期間，暫停該州所有死刑執行。派克的法律團隊認為，此事件凸顯了死刑程序中深層的系統性缺失。當局尚未解釋為何該程序未能結束她的生命。

paragraphs.en: The head of the prison system in the US state of Tennessee is stepping down after a failed execution attempt left an inmate in critical condition. Governor Bill Lee announced on Saturday that Commissioner Frank Strada will leave his position later this month. This decision follows the attempted execution of Christa Pike, which took place on Wednesday and resulted in a medical emergency rather than the intended outcome.
paragraphs.zh: 美國田納西州的監獄系統負責人在一起失敗的死刑執行導致一名囚犯陷入病危後，宣布辭職。州長比爾·李（Bill Lee）於週六宣布，懲教署署長法蘭克·斯特拉達（Frank Strada）將於本月稍晚離職。此項決定是在克莉絲塔·派克（Christa Pike）的死刑執行嘗試失敗後做出的，該事件發生於週三，最終演變成醫療緊急狀況，而非預期的結果。

paragraphs.en: According to BBC News, the failed procedure has led to a complete pause on all executions in Tennessee for the remainder of the year. Governor Lee stated that he appreciates Commissioner Strada’s willingness to put the interests of the state first during this difficult time. In a joint statement, Strada noted that his resignation is in the best interests of the public while an independent review of the incident moves forward. He described the investigation as entirely appropriate and necessary.
paragraphs.zh: 根據英國廣播公司新聞（BBC News）報導，這次失敗的程序已導致田納西州今年剩餘時間內全面暫停執行死刑。李州長表示，他感謝斯特拉達署長在如此艱難時刻願意將州政府的利益置於首位。斯特拉達在一份聯合聲明中指出，在針對此事件進行獨立審查的過程中，他的辭職最符合公眾利益。他形容這項調查是完全適當且必要的。

paragraphs.en: Christa Pike, who was sentenced to death in 1996 for the murder of 19-year-old Colleen Slemmer, survived two injections of pentobarbital. Deutsche Welle (DW) reports that witnesses heard Pike crying and moaning during the process. Following the failed attempt, she was transported by ambulance to a hospital in Nashville. As of late last week, she remained unconscious and was being kept alive by a ventilator. Her medical team is currently working to remove the lethal drugs from her body.
paragraphs.zh: 克莉絲塔·派克因於一九九六年謀殺十九歲的柯琳·史萊默（Colleen Slemmer）而被判處死刑，她在接受兩劑戊巴比妥注射後倖存。德國之聲（DW）報導稱，目擊者在過程中聽到了派克的哭泣與呻吟聲。在這次失敗的執行後，她被救護車送往納許維爾的一家醫院。截至上週末，她仍處於昏迷狀態，並依靠呼吸器維持生命。她的醫療團隊目前正致力於將致命藥物從她體內排出。

paragraphs.en: This incident has raised serious questions about the state's execution methods. Pike’s lawyers have argued that her specific medical history, including a blood-clotting condition and small veins, made the lethal injection process dangerous and likely to cause unnecessary pain. Her legal team believes that problems with the intravenous (IV) lines may have caused the drugs to flow incorrectly into her body instead of her bloodstream. While the Department of Correction has defended its protocol, stating that it followed established rules, the failure has prompted a wider discussion about the state's death penalty system.
paragraphs.zh: 此事件引發了對該州死刑執行方式的嚴重質疑。派克的律師主張，她特殊的病史，包括凝血功能異常與血管細小，使得致命注射過程變得危險，且極可能造成不必要的痛苦。她的法律團隊認為，靜脈注射管線的問題可能導致藥物未能正確進入血液循環，而是流向了身體其他部位。儘管懲教署為其程序辯護，聲稱已遵循既定規則，但此次失敗已引發了關於該州死刑制度更廣泛的討論。

paragraphs.en: Pike’s attorneys have welcomed the resignation of the prison chief but emphasized that it does not solve the immediate problems facing their client. In a statement provided to BBC News, the legal team noted that what happened on Wednesday reflects a systemic failure that goes far beyond the actions of any single person. They expressed hope that the governor’s call for a full, independent review will expose the profound problems within the entire system. Meanwhile, the lawyers have filed an emergency motion to ensure that all evidence related to the failed execution is preserved for future investigation.
paragraphs.zh: 派克的律師對監獄首長的辭職表示歡迎，但強調這並未解決其當事人目前面臨的迫切問題。法律團隊在提供給英國廣播公司新聞的聲明中指出，週三發生的事件反映了一種遠超個人行為的系統性缺失。他們表示希望州長所要求的全面獨立審查，能揭露整個制度內部的深層問題。同時，律師團已提交緊急動議，以確保所有與此次失敗執行相關的證據皆能被妥善保存，供未來調查使用。

paragraphs.en: The case of Christa Pike has been a long and controversial one. She was only 18 years old when she and her then-boyfriend were involved in the 1995 killing of Colleen Slemmer near the University of Tennessee in Knoxville. The murder received significant media attention at the time. Pike was sentenced to death the following year and has remained the only woman on Tennessee’s death row. Had the execution been successful, she would have been the first woman executed by the state since 1820.
paragraphs.zh: 克莉絲塔·派克的案件長期以來備受爭議。一九九五年，當時年僅十八歲的她與當時的男友在田納西大學諾克斯維爾分校附近參與了殺害柯琳·史萊默的案件。這起謀殺案在當時引起了媒體的高度關注。派克於隔年被判處死刑，並一直是田納西州死刑犯中唯一的女性。若此次執行成功，她將成為該州自一八二○年以來首位被處決的女性。

paragraphs.en: This is not the first time Tennessee has faced complications with its execution procedures. Deutsche Welle (DW) reports that this is the second time this year that an execution in the state has had to be halted. The state government has not yet offered a clear explanation for why the drugs failed to kill Pike, nor have they stated whether they intend to attempt the execution again in the future. For now, the focus remains on the medical care of the prisoner and the upcoming independent review.
paragraphs.zh: 這並非田納西州首次在死刑執行程序上遭遇困難。德國之聲報導稱，這是該州今年第二次必須中斷死刑執行。州政府尚未針對藥物為何未能結束派克的生命提供明確解釋，也未說明未來是否打算再次嘗試執行死刑。目前，焦點仍集中在囚犯的醫療照護以及即將進行的獨立審查上。

paragraphs.en: As the state prepares for a thorough investigation, the incident has left many questioning the reliability of lethal injection as a method of punishment. With the governor’s order to halt all executions, the state is under pressure to prove that its systems are safe and fair. The resignation of Commissioner Strada marks a significant turning point, but as Pike’s lawyers pointed out, the core issues regarding the state’s death penalty practices remain a subject of intense debate.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著該州準備進行徹底調查，此事件讓許多人質疑致命注射作為懲罰手段的可靠性。在州長下令暫停所有死刑執行後，該州面臨證明其系統安全且公平的壓力。斯特拉達署長的辭職標誌著一個重要的轉折點，但正如派克的律師所指出的，關於該州死刑實務的核心問題，仍是激烈辯論的主題。

keyTerms.definitionEn: To resign or leave a position of authority.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見於新聞報導政治或高層職位變動，容易與「走下台階」的字面意思混淆。文中：The head of the prison system in the US state of Tennessee is stepping down after a failed execution attempt left an inmate in critical condition.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To continue to happen or make progress.
keyTerms.noteZh: 這裡指調查工作正在進行，而非字面上的「向前移動」。文中：In a joint statement, Strada noted that his resignation is in the best interests of the public while an independent review of the incident moves forward.
此詞在正式新聞中常用於指代「暫時中止」某項計畫或行動。文中：Deutsche Welle (DW) reports that this is the second time this year that an execution in the state has had to be halted.

previousArticles.title: Failed Execution in Tennessee Sparks New Debate on Death Penalty
previousArticles.summaryEn: A failed execution in Tennessee has left prisoner Christa Pike in critical condition after two doses of lethal drugs failed to end her life. This incident is the first time a prisoner has survived a lethal injection process in the United States. State officials have paused all upcoming executions to investigate the cause of the failure. The event has reignited a national debate about the fairness and morality of capital punishment. Critics argue that the use of lethal injections is cruel and should be abolished entirely.

quiz.question: What is the current medical status of Christa Pike following the failed execution?

options.A: She has fully recovered and is back in her prison cell.
options.B: She is unconscious and requires a ventilator to survive.
options.C: She is being treated for injuries caused by the removal of the IV lines.
options.D: She is conscious but remains in critical condition under police guard.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第三段，Pike 在失敗的執行後被送往醫院，當時她處於無意識狀態（unconscious），並且必須依賴呼吸器（ventilator）維持生命。選項 A 錯誤，因為她尚未康復；選項 C 雖然提到醫療團隊在處理藥物，但未提及因移除管線導致受傷；選項 D 錯誤，因為文章明確指出她處於無意識狀態。

quiz.question: Based on the article, why might the lawyers argue that the execution process was inherently flawed for Christa Pike?

options.A: The prison staff intentionally ignored the medical protocol to cause her pain.
options.B: The state lacks the necessary equipment to perform executions on female inmates.
options.C: Her specific physiological characteristics made the standard lethal injection procedure dangerous.
options.D: The drugs used by the state were expired and therefore ineffective.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據第四段，律師指出 Pike 有特殊的醫療病史，包括血液凝固問題和血管較細（small veins），這些生理特徵使得標準的靜脈注射過程變得危險。選項 A 無法由文中推論，因為文中提到懲教署堅稱已遵循既定規則；選項 B 錯誤，文中未提及性別與設備的關聯；選項 D 錯誤，文中並未提及藥物過期，僅提到藥物未正確進入血液循環。

quiz.question: In the fifth paragraph, what does the word 'systemic' mean as used in the context of the lawyers' statement?

options.A: Relating to a widespread problem inherent within an entire organization or structure.
options.B: Caused by a temporary mistake made by a specific individual in charge.
options.C: A medical condition that affects the entire body rather than one specific part.
options.D: A legal term referring to the rules of evidence in capital punishment cases.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。在此上下文中，律師認為失敗不僅是個人的錯誤，而是「systemic failure」（系統性失敗），意指問題根植於整個執行體系中。選項 B 與文意相反，律師強調這超越了個人的行為；選項 C 雖然在醫學上可指全身性，但在本段法律評論的脈絡下，是指組織結構的問題；選項 D 錯誤，這並非法律術語的定義。

quiz.question: What is the central message of this article regarding the failed execution in Tennessee?

options.A: The resignation of Commissioner Frank Strada will likely lead to the immediate resumption of executions.
options.B: The failed execution of Christa Pike has prompted a broader investigation into the reliability and safety of the state's death penalty system.
options.C: Christa Pike's lawyers are primarily focused on ensuring she is released from prison due to the state's incompetence.
options.D: The state of Tennessee has officially abolished the death penalty following the medical emergency on Wednesday.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。文章核心在於報導 Pike 執行失敗的事件，以及此事件如何引發對田納西州死刑制度的質疑、官員辭職，以及對獨立調查的需求。選項 A 錯誤，因為執行已暫停；選項 C 錯誤，律師並未要求釋放她，而是要求保存證據與調查；選項 D 錯誤，文中僅提到暫停（pause）執行，並未宣告廢除死刑。
